title: Allow subordinate implementation and business rule adaptation within Codex principles
summary: Principle-only: owners may adapt external implementation/business rules without conflicting with the sole Codex authority; preserve authorization,verification,isolation and rollback; no adaptive runtime implementation
origin: direct human-governor instruction: 實作規則與業務規則自適化，以不牴觸法典為原則;law only

changes.proposed: SCOPE:the Codex records principles only,including legitimate authority,ownership boundaries,separation of duties,permission,data custody,isolation,safety,accountability,evidence,independent verification,interpretation and governed change. EXCLUSION:implementation rules and business rules do not enter the Codex;algorithms,programming languages,software stacks,files,paths,APIs,schemas,protocol layouts,technical versions,model topology,parameters,thresholds,test-suite composition,scheduling procedures and business decision procedures belong to their governed owners outside the Codex. APPLICABILITY:this boundary controls every general provision,special law,ordinance and purported normative registry payload;registration,format or writing style cannot turn an excluded detail into a legal principle. EXTERNAL-OWNERSHIP:owner-local contracts,policies,configuration and business specifications are subordinate operational artifacts,not independent normative authorities;their validity and permitted effects derive exclusively from applicable current Codex principles and granted ownership.They cannot create legal duties,enlarge permissions,override a principle or establish another law source. REFERENCES:the Codex may identify the responsible owner and controlling principle without importing the external rule payload or making an implementation choice a legal mandate. LEGACY:excluded details remaining in existing records are non-operative legacy material for lawful owner-local migration,not current Codex authority;principles contained in a mixed record remain binding. MIGRATION:migration requires attributable ownership,evidence and independent validation;unresolved custody or equivalence remains incomplete and cannot be declared complete by relabeling. SAFETY:separating principles from implementation does not waive current permissions,approved safety controls,independent verification or release gates;uncertain authority fails closed. AUTHORITY:A1 establishes the current authoritative Codex as the sole normative authority;only its governed current principles have legal effect.General law,special law and express exceptions remain within the one Codex;translations,mirrors,registries,external rules,implementation projections and audit measurements create no additional law. ADAPTATION:implementation rules and business rules maintained outside the Codex may adapt to observed conditions,requirements and verified outcomes within the assigned owner's existing authority,applicable permissions and current Codex principles;every adaptation remains subordinate and must not conflict with the Codex.Non-conflict is a necessary boundary,not a substitute for required authorization,confirmation,independent verification or release acceptance.GOVERNED-ADAPTATION:changes remain attributable,purpose-bound,scope-bounded,auditable and reversible where applicable;verification must be proportionate to affected risk and preserve accountability,separation of duties,custody,isolation and applicable safety controls.NO-SELF-EXPANSION:adaptation cannot create new authority or permissions,change a governing principle,weaken prohibitions,waive evidence gates or bypass an unresolved obligation.CHANGE-BOUNDARY:an owner-local adaptation that remains wholly within current principles and granted powers is not a Codex amendment and does not import its rule payload into law;any proposed change to those principles or granted powers requires a prior governed Codex amendment and any consequential action still requires its applicable authorization.UNCERTAINTY:unresolved conflict,scope or conformance fails closed for the affected change;retain the last verified lawful state only while it remains safe and authorized,otherwise stop the affected action.
